decisions.reason: As a strategic flagship service aligned with the firm's established maritime management and offshore expansion, it is very unlikely to be dropped.
Crew and corporate travel management complements core maritime services and supports client relationships, making withdrawal unlikely.
As a flagship digital portal built on established services, it supports the firm's stated broadening of service scope and is likely to remain.
The mobile performance app builds on existing vessel operations and, while a digital tool has some lifecycle risk, it remains worth keeping.
